title: Run from the template until the gate suspends the session

turns.prompt:
RESUME run={RUN_ID}

Begin the run: work the main loop from the current state.

notes: The hard denial check covers write tools only: the engine's own writes are whitelisted while the gate is pending, so a denied write is a hook defect. A shell call the model makes after suspending - a read-only check of its own work - is denied by design once this session is the bound driver, and whether a model makes one is its habit, not the hook's behaviour; that count is advisory, as in adversarial.
